items.stem: Which Real-Time Intelligence component ingests streaming data from sources like Event Hubs and routes it to a destination with a no-code experience?

options.rationale: Correct: eventstream is the no-code pipeline that captures, transforms and routes real-time events.
An eventhouse stores and analyzes the data; it is the destination, not the ingestion pipeline.
A semantic model is a Power BI concept, not a streaming ingestion component.
Deployment pipelines promote content between stages; they do not ingest streams.

items.stem: A team needs fast filtering and aggregation over billions of time-series events. Which store and language are purpose-built for this?

options.rationale: Correct: eventhouses are built for streaming/time-series data and use KQL for fast queries.

options.text: A warehouse queried only with batch exports
options.rationale: Batch exports do not provide the low-latency event analysis an eventhouse does.
A dashboard visualizes results; it is not the analytics store or query language.
Dataverse is an application data platform, not a time-series event store.

items.stem: Which TWO things can Activator do in Real-Time Intelligence? (Select TWO)

options.text: Send a notification when a defined condition is met
options.rationale: Correct: Activator is a no-code rules engine that alerts on conditions.

options.text: Trigger a Fabric job when a rule fires
options.rationale: Correct: Activator can trigger Fabric jobs when a condition is met.

options.text: Store billions of events for KQL queries
options.rationale: Storing events is the eventhouse's role, not Activator's.
Activator acts on data; it does not ingest streams.

items.explanation: Correct: Activator is a no-code rules engine that alerts on conditions.
